title: Head of Artificial Intelligence
job_description: Reports to: CEO Work Authorization: Employment Pass (EP) sponsorship available Key Responsibilities • Design, build, and deploy internal AI agents for Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams. • Architect solutions on the Microsoft 365 platform, including Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Microsoft Graph API, and Azure AI Foundry. • Recruit and lead a cross-functional team of engineers and designers. • Own end-to-end adoption metrics, with daily active usage as the primary success indicator. • Partner with the CEO to drive AI adoption and organizational change. Language Requirements • Full professional proficiency in English. • Conversational Mandarin proficiency. Required Qualifications • Hands-on experience in designing and building AI agents or AI-powered products. • Strong technical proficiency in the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, including Copilot Studio and Power Platform. • Background in CPaaS, CCaaS, or enterprise SaaS, with understanding of contact center and conversational AI solutions. • Proven track record of driving technology adoption and organizational change, with measurable results. Preferred Qualifications • Prior experience delivering production-grade solutions on Microsoft Copilot or related platforms. • Prior experience in CPaaS/CCaaS companies or Microsoft implementation partners. • Strong bias toward rapid prototyping and iterative delivery.
